title: Ana Reyes
body: Ana Reyes leads the Platform team at Lumen Labs. She owns the queue migration and runs the weekly reliability review.

title: Ben Okafor
body: Ben Okafor is a staff engineer on the Data team. He is the go-to person for the billing pipeline.

title: Atlas queue migration
body: Atlas moves every background job off the legacy RabbitMQ cluster onto a managed queue.

title: Ledger billing pipeline
body: Ledger rebuilds the nightly billing export as a streaming pipeline.

title: Atlas will move to Amazon SQS
body: We chose Amazon SQS as the target queue for Atlas because the team already runs on AWS.

title: Atlas will move to NATS JetStream instead of SQS
body: After load testing, we replaced the SQS decision: Atlas moves to NATS JetStream, because SQS could not meet our ordering needs.

title: Write the Atlas cutover runbook
body: Document the step-by-step cutover from RabbitMQ to the new queue, with rollback.

title: Backfill six months of billing events
body: Replay six months of billing events into the new Ledger pipeline to validate totals.

title: Billing export skipped a day
body: The nightly billing export silently skipped June 12. Customers were invoiced a day late. Root cause: a cron job ran in the wrong timezone.

title: Load test NATS JetStream with production traffic
body: Replay a day of production job traffic against JetStream and record p99 latency.
